required.reason: Product-neutral projection of the pinned upstream CSS Syntax declaration and recovery cases onto WebScene's supported CSSOM/computed-style surface. It isolates syntax tokenization from property grammar, selectors, cascade, and layout so the legacy splitter and cssparser variants can be compared directly.
Reduced Kestrel dark/light theme and interaction recascade regression. This local contract does not establish upstream WPT or pixel presentation conformance.

CSSOM computed-style and geometry reads are synchronous style-recalculation barriers. WebScene may coalesce repeated invalidations within one browser task, but declaration removal must restore stylesheet and inherited values before any observable read in that task.
Color-mix percentages must stay inside the color component instead of becoming border widths. Local regression pending cross-RID qualification.

Product-neutral reduction of the named-area composition used by Code OSS Welcome. It covers normalized CSSOM serialization, sparse rectangular areas across fractional and minmax tracks, atomic rejection of nonrectangular or unequal rows, synchronous mutation/removal layout, and a bounded 500-mutation gate.

Product-neutral reduction of an external SVG badge composition. Native must preserve all four CSS longhands and independently emit the loaded SVG at the certified scene coordinates. Keep candidate until background-image paint is stable on every released native RID; native authority is test_svg_background_image_reaches_scene_with_position_and_size.

Browser-authorized reduction of TradingView's device breakpoint manager: retained MediaQueryList objects must update their matches snapshots, notify modern and legacy listeners exactly once when a host resize crosses a breakpoint, remain silent within a breakpoint, and stop notifying removed listeners.

Product-neutral reduction of a finite status animation whose animationend listener removes the triggering class. It requires one browser-shaped terminal event after an unrelated mid-animation recascade and proves listener cleanup completes without restarting the animation. Native host-demand release is additionally asserted by the deterministic ABI regression.
